integrity: Mathematical proof covers every graph and every field for centralizers, and every prime power for counts; finite computer checks are corroborative, not a general proof. Originality is a qualified literature-based assessment, not independent certification.
limitations: Restricted to simple undirected graphs and the two-step Lie bracket with one independent central basis generator per edge; no shared edge labels or isomorphism-class counts. An equivalent independent-edge rank calculation could have appeared in uncatalogued graph or Lie literature; the graph polynomial Q is established prior work.
title: Support components determine centralizers and commuting counts in graph Lie algebras
